name: atma_authenticate_farmer
description: Authenticates a farmer using Aadhaar and mobile OTP to establish a session. Requires the farmer to have a valid Aadhaar linked to the provided mobile number. aadhaar_number must be exactly 12 digits, mobile_number must be exactly 10 digits, and otp must be a 6-digit numeric string. Returns session_token, authentication_status, and timestamp. Does not register the farmer in the ATMA database or create a farmer profile. Fails if the OTP is incorrect, expired, or if the mobile number is not linked to the provided Aadhaar.

otp.description: 6-digit one time password received on the mobile number [EXACT]

name: atma_find_nearest_kvk
description: Finds the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) and extension officers for a given district and state. Requires no prior state or authentication. state and district must be valid Indian administrative divisions within the ATMA network. Returns kvk_id, kvk_name, address, contact_number, and a list of extension_officer names. Does not schedule visits or book appointments with the KVK officers. Fails if the district has no established KVK or if the state and district combination is invalid.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

village_name.description: Name of the village to find the most localized extension officer [SUBSTRING]

name: atma_get_sms_contact
description: Retrieves contact details for Subject Matter Specialists (SMS) by crop and district. Requires no prior state or authentication. district must be in the ATMA network and crop_name must be a recognized agricultural commodity. Returns specialist_id, specialist_name, designation, contact_number, and availability_hours. Does not submit queries to the specialist or guarantee their immediate availability. Fails if no specialist is assigned for the specified crop in the given district.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

crop_name.description: Name of the crop for which specialist contact is needed [EXACT]

name: atma_get_advisory_bulletin
description: Fetches the latest crop-specific advisory bulletin published by ICAR and state agriculture departments. Requires no prior state or authentication. district must be valid, crop_name must be notified for the district, and crop_stage must be a valid stage. Returns bulletin_id, publish_date, advisory_text, and advisory_type. Does not provide weather forecasting, market prices, or PMFBY crop insurance details. Fails if no advisory bulletin is available for the requested crop stage or if the district is invalid.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

crop_name.description: Name of the crop for the advisory [EXACT]

crop_stage.description: Current growth stage of the crop [EXACT]

name: atma_get_ipm_advisory
description: Retrieves Integrated Pest Management (IPM) advisories for specific pests and crops. Requires no prior state or authentication. crop_name must be valid and pest_category must be a recognized category. Returns ipm_advisory_id, pest_name, control_measures, safety_precautions, and last_updated_date. Does not facilitate the purchase of pesticides, inputs, or seeds recommended in the advisory. Fails if the IPM advisory is stale (last updated more than 7 days ago during active season) or if no data exists for the pest.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

pest_category.description: Category of the pest affecting the crop [EXACT]

name: atma_get_demonstration_schedule
description: Looks up schedules and locations for upcoming agricultural demonstration plots. Requires no prior state or authentication. district must be valid and crop_name must be a recognized crop. Returns demonstration_id, plot_location, scheduled_date, crop_variety, and organizing_officer. Does not register the farmer for the demonstration or provide transport to the plot. Fails if no demonstrations are scheduled for the specified crop in the district.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

crop_name.description: Name of the crop being demonstrated [EXACT]

name: atma_get_technology_package
description: Recommends comprehensive technology packages for specific crops based on agro-climatic zones. Requires no prior state or authentication. crop_name must be valid and agro_climatic_zone must be a recognized Indian ecological zone. Returns package_id, variety_selection, spacing_guidance, input_schedule, and harvesting_guidance. Does not provide soil test scheduling (SHC scheme) or PM-KUSUM solar pump recommendations. Fails if the technology package is not available for the farmer's agro-climatic zone or crop.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop for the technology package [EXACT]

agro_climatic_zone.description: Agro-climatic zone of the farming location [EXACT]

name: atma_get_available_trainings
description: Lists upcoming ATMA training programmes by district, crop, and training mode. Requires no prior state or authentication. district must be valid and training_mode must be a recognized delivery method. Returns a list of trainings containing training_id, topic, scheduled_date, venue, training_mode, and programme_availability. Does not register the user for any of the listed training programmes. Fails if no trainings match the criteria or if the district is invalid.

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

crop_name.description: Optional crop name to filter training programmes [EXACT]

name: atma_register_farmer_profile
description: Registers a farmer in the district-level ATMA database to enable training and query features. Requires an authenticated session and farmer_profile_status: not_registered. session_token must be active, district and state must match ATMA coverage, and farmer_name must not be empty. Returns farmer_id, registration_date, and updated farmer_profile_status. Does not enroll the farmer in PM-KISAN income support or any financial subsidy schemes. Fails if the session is invalid, if the farmer is already registered, or if the profile is suspended due to data mismatch.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

farmer_name.description: Full name of the farmer as per official records [SUBSTRING]

state.description: Indian state name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

village_name.description: Name of the farmer's residential village [SUBSTRING]

name: atma_register_for_training
description: Registers a farmer for an upcoming ATMA training programme at a KVK or farm school. Requires an authenticated session and a farmer profile with farmer_profile_status: registered or verified. session_token must be active and training_id must be a valid upcoming programme identifier. Returns registration_id, confirmed_date, venue, and training_registration_status. Does not confirm attendance or issue a training certificate. Fails if the training programme is full (programme_availability: full or closed), if the farmer is already registered for the same programme, or if training_mode is online but the farmer lacks internet access.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

name: atma_confirm_training_attendance
description: Confirms a farmer's attendance at a scheduled ATMA training programme. Requires an authenticated session, farmer_profile_status: registered, and training_registration_status: registered or waitlisted. session_token must be active, training_id must match a programme the farmer is registered for, and attendance_code must be valid. Returns attendance_id, confirmation_timestamp, and updated training_registration_status. Does not automatically download or generate the physical training certificate. Fails if the training has not yet occurred, if the farmer was not registered, or if the attendance code is invalid.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

attendance_code.description: Secret code provided by the instructor at the venue [EXACT]

name: atma_download_training_certificate
description: Downloads the official certificate for a completed ATMA training programme. Requires an authenticated session and training_registration_status: attended. session_token must be active and training_id must correspond to a completed programme. Returns certificate_id, download_url, issue_date, and certificate_status. Does not modify the farmer's attendance record or profile status. Fails if certificate_status is not_issued, if attendance is not confirmed, or if the certificate was revoked.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

name: atma_schedule_farm_school_visit
description: Schedules a visit to a local farm school for practical agricultural demonstrations. Requires an authenticated session and farmer_profile_status: registered or verified. session_token must be active, district must be valid, and preferred_date must be in the future. Returns visit_id, farm_school_name, scheduled_date, host_farmer_name, and farm_school_visit_status. Does not arrange transportation to the farm school or provide financial compensation for the visit. Fails if the farm school visit is cancelled by KVK, if no slots are available on the preferred date, or if the farmer profile is suspended.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

preferred_date.description: Desired date for the farm school visit in YYYY-MM-DD format [EXACT]

name: atma_submit_expert_query
description: Submits a crop-related query to a Subject Matter Specialist (SMS) for expert advice. Requires an authenticated session and farmer_profile_status: registered. session_token must be active, crop_name must be valid, and query_text must not be empty. Returns query_id, assigned_specialist_name, expected_response_date, and query_status. Does not guarantee an expert response within the 3-day SLA or provide real-time chat. Fails if no SMS is available for the crop in the district, or if the query text exceeds maximum length limits.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

district.description: Indian district name in lowercase underscore form [EXACT]

crop_name.description: Name of the crop related to the query [EXACT]

query_text.description: Detailed description of the agricultural problem or question [SUBSTRING]

name: atma_track_query_response
description: Tracks the status and retrieves the response for a previously submitted expert query. Requires an authenticated session and query_status: submitted, assigned, or responded. session_token must be active and query_id must be a valid identifier belonging to the authenticated farmer. Returns query_id, current_query_status, specialist_response_text, and response_date. Does not allow the farmer to reply directly to the specialist's response. Fails if the query_id is invalid, if the query belongs to another farmer, or if the query_status is not_submitted.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

query_id.description: Unique expert query identifier assigned at submission [EXACT]

name: atma_raise_grievance
description: Files a grievance regarding ATMA services, such as an unresponsive officer or missed advisory. Requires an authenticated session and farmer_profile_status: registered. session_token must be active, grievance_category must be valid, and grievance_details must be provided. Returns grievance_id, filing_date, expected_resolution_date, and grievance_status. Does not handle grievances related to eNAM mandi trade, PM-KISAN payments, or PMFBY insurance claims. Fails if filing a grievance about an officer where no query was submitted, or if the grievance details are insufficient.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that create or modify farmer registrations, queries, or training records [TYPE_ONLY]

grievance_category.description: Category of the grievance being filed [EXACT]

officer_id.description: Identifier of the officer involved, if applicable [EXACT]

query_id.description: Unique expert query identifier assigned at submission [EXACT]

name: atma_track_grievance_status
description: Checks the current status and resolution remarks of a filed grievance. Requires no prior state or authentication. grievance_id must be a valid, existing identifier. Returns grievance_id, grievance_status, resolution_remarks, and last_updated_date. Does not allow modification or escalation of the grievance details. Fails if the grievance_id does not exist or if the grievance_status is not_filed.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier of the filed grievance [EXACT]
